label: Bone sarcoma (osteosarcoma, Ewing sarcoma, chondrosarcoma)

approval.note: Draft checklist from NCG Guidelines for Bone and Soft Tissue Tumours (2019): needs a clinician's check

site_note: V2 item 5.3 (two primaries): only on a Case File linked to the same patient's other Case File, and only for histopathology, cytology, IHC and molecular records: among several candidates for one record, or several documents carrying a required value, one that names another protocol's site and not this one steps aside and is named on the row for review; a document naming no site never does, and when every candidate names another site every candidate stays. Organ words only. A preference, never a filter; a patient with one cancer is checked as before.
note: DRAFT, not approved for real use: needs a clinician's check. Configurable by the clinical team. Required records transcribed from the NCG Guidelines for Bone and Soft Tissue Tumours (2019) (National Cancer Grid, India), the bone sarcoma pages (evaluation p 4, osteosarcoma p 7, Ewing sarcoma p 12, chondrosarcoma p 17, appendices p 25 to 40; the PDF page is the printed page), each with its verbatim quote and page. Tiers printed by NCG are kept; the tiers whose tier_basis says 'proposed' are proposals, to be confirmed by the hospital Tumour Board (clinical review before real use). A record NCG gives only under a condition the system never judges (a finding, a plan) is shown with NCG's own tier and the condition, never counted. The stage and the risk group are as recorded by the clinician, never computed. Nothing here suggests treatment. There are three settings because the work-up differs: the chondrosarcoma flow has no alkaline phosphatase and LDH, no immunohistochemistry and no baseline organ tests, and prints the bone scan as Optional. The book has no Enneking and no bone-specific stage table. Echocardiogram and audiometry before chemotherapy are one line of the book (p 28), listed as separate records so each goes to the team that does it. Ewing sarcoma and osteosarcoma are not in the paediatric book. A child's treating team is Paediatric Oncology: clinical records go to the owner of the Case File.
settings_note: Setting of the Case File, chosen by the clinician from what the signed reports record (the system never computes stage and never decides the setting). The three settings follow the book's sections: Osteosarcoma (p 7), Ewing sarcoma (p 12) and Chondrosarcoma (p 17). Non-metastatic and metastatic are not settings: the work-up is common and the split follows staging. Each record carries its tier per setting; until a setting is recorded the strictest tier applies. Draft checklist: needs a clinician's check.
